modes.Domination: singleplayer, defeat all tribes in as few turns as possible; up to 10 opponents
modes.Glory: multiplayer; first to 10,000 points and hold the lead one turn

capital_income_per_turn.note: TOTAL starting capital income, not a bonus on top: wiki Game Modes says 'Normal 2 (same as humans)'. So Easy bots earn LESS than a human (C24).

bot_difficulty.aggression: higher ratings on higher difficulty (no numbers)
bot_difficulty.implication: bots win by income handicap, not by planning; their decision policy is undocumented. Needs black-box observation (replay logs).
